question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Atempt"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Attempt"**. (प्रयास)

 
 
• **Example: **He made an attempt to climb the mountain.
 
 
 
• **"Attempt"** refers to an effort to achieve or complete a challenging task. (प्रयास)
 
 
• **Example: **She made a second attempt to pass the exam.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Guilty** (दोषी): Responsible for a specified wrongdoing.

 
 
• **Example: **He felt guilty for lying to his friend.
 
 
 
• **Admit** (स्वीकार करना): Confess to be true or to be the case.
 
 
• **Example: **She admitted to making a mistake.
 
 
 
• **Agree** (सहमत होना): Have the same opinion about something; concur.
 
 
• **Example: **We all agreed on the need for change.
